title: A Surprise for Grandma
description: A family plans a secret birthday party for their grandmother.
instructions: Read the text about a birthday surprise, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: Grandma Rose was going to be seventy on Saturday. Her grandchildren, Ben and Lily, wanted to do something special for her. They decided to have a surprise party at their house. They told everyone in the family, but they did not tell Grandma.

On Saturday morning, Dad took Grandma to the park for a long walk. While they were out, Mum and the children got the house ready. Ben put balloons and flowers in the living room. Lily made a big chocolate cake, because it was Grandma's favourite.

At four o'clock, about twenty people were hiding in the living room. They heard the front door open, and everyone was very quiet. When Grandma walked in, they all jumped up and shouted 'Surprise!' Grandma put her hands on her face and started to cry.

But Grandma was not sad at all. 'These are happy tears,' she said with a big smile. She talked with her family and old friends until late in the evening. Before she went home, she said it was the best birthday of her life.

The next day, Ben and Lily went to Grandma's house to help her clean up. There were many cards and presents on her table. Grandma read every card twice. Her favourite present was a photo album from Ben and Lily. It had old photos of the whole family, from Grandma's wedding to Lily's first birthday. On the first page, Lily wrote 'For the best grandma in the world' in big red letters.

'How did you find all these photos?' Grandma asked. Lily explained that they looked in boxes at Aunt Sarah's house for two weeks. Some photos were very old and a little dirty, so Ben cleaned them carefully. Grandma turned the pages slowly and told the children a story about every picture. They stayed with her all afternoon and drank lots of tea.

Now the album is on a small table next to Grandma's armchair. When friends visit her, she always shows it to them. Ben and Lily are already planning the next surprise. Dad is going to be forty-five in May, and they want to make a short film about his life. They know it is going to be harder, because Dad always asks a lot of questions!
